text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Symptoms of overdose in patients with peanut allergy may include hypersensitivity reactions such as anaphylaxis or local gastrointestinal allergic reactions [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1 and 5.5) ] . In case of severe symptoms such as difficulty in swallowing, difficulty in breathing, changes in voice, feeling of fullness in the throat, or anaphylaxis, patients should be instructed to use epinephrine and seek immediate medical assistance [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) and Patient Counseling Information (17) ] .
